user.title: Connect to Zee Refrigerator
user.description: Enter the fridge's local IP address, and choose how to set up the local key.

manual_key.title: Enter the local key
manual_key.description: Paste the fridge's current local key. It rotates periodically — if it stops working later, use Configure on this integration to update it, or link a Haier account so rotations refresh automatically.

discovery_confirm.title: Zee Refrigerator found
discovery_confirm.description: Found a Haier fridge at {host} (device {device}). Choose how to set up the local key.

account.title: Sign in with your Haier account
account.description: Used only to fetch the local key and to automatically re-fetch it when it rotates. Only a durable token is stored — your password is never saved. The country is where the account was registered, not where you live or where the fridge is.

data.zone_info: Country/region where the account was registered

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the fridge at that IP (UDP discovery failed), or could not reach Haier's cloud.
error.invalid_key: Could not decrypt a status report with this key. It may be stale — re-fetch the current local key.
error.no_status_report: Connected, but no 151-byte status report was received.
error.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed — check your email/phone and password.
error.invalid_auth_detail: Sign-in failed: {detail}. Check your email/phone and password, or that this account is registered on the Haier SE-Asia cloud used by the Haismart app.
error.key_fetch_failed: Signed in, but fetching the local key from the cloud gateway failed.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the fridge at the discovered address.

init.title: Zee Refrigerator options
init.description: Leave the key and account fields blank to just change the poll interval. The status length and byte map are advanced settings for other fridge models.

data.login_id: Haier account email/phone (link account for auto re-key)
data.zone_info: Country/region where the account was registered

error.invalid_key: Could not decrypt a status report with this key.
error.no_status_report: Connected, but no status report of the expected length was received.
error.invalid_auth: Sign-in failed — check your email/phone and password, or the local key fetch failed.
error.invalid_status_len: Status report length must be between 1 and 512 bytes.
error.invalid_layout: The byte map is not valid JSON, or contains invalid field values.

stale_localkey.title: Zee Refrigerator: local key rotated
stale_localkey.description: The fridge's local key has rotated (was v{old}, now v{new}) and no Haier account is linked to auto-refresh it. Go to Settings > Devices & services > {name} > Configure to link an account, or paste the current key by hand.

key_refresh_failed.title: Zee Refrigerator: automatic re-key failed
key_refresh_failed.description: The fridge's local key rotated (was v{old}, now v{new}) and the linked Haier account could not fetch a fresh one. Check the account credentials under Settings > Devices & services > {name} > Configure, or paste the current key by hand.
